sw.intro: Jifunze kuendesha pikipiki kwa usalama. Gusa somo, sikiliza, kisha chagua: Salama au Hatari?
sw.allDone: Umemaliza masomo yote. Chukua cheti chako!
sw.certBody: amekamilisha mafunzo yote ya usalama wa pikipiki
sw.certReady: Hiki ni cheti chako. Andika jina lako, kisha kishiriki na marafiki.
sw.disclaimer: Haya ni mafunzo ya jumla tu. Hayachukui nafasi ya mafunzo rasmi ya udereva, leseni halali, wala sheria za barabarani za nchi yako. Maudhui na sauti zimetengenezwa kwa msaada wa akili mnemba (AI).

en.intro: Learn to ride a motorcycle safely. Tap a lesson, listen, then choose: Safe or Danger?
en.moduleDone: Well done! You finished this lesson.
en.allDone: You finished all the lessons. Get your certificate!
en.certBody: has completed all the motorcycle safety lessons
en.certReady: This is your certificate. Write your name, then share it with your friends.
en.disclaimer: This is general safety education only. It does not replace formal rider training, a valid licence, or the traffic laws of your country. The content and voices were made with the help of AI.
en.brand: Brought to you by Masika Ventures

text.sw: Kabla ya kuondoka, kagua pikipiki yako kila siku.
text.en: Check your motorcycle every day before you ride.

text.sw: Angalia matairi: yawe na upepo wa kutosha na yasiwe yameisha.
text.en: Check the tyres: they need enough air and must not be worn out.

text.sw: Jaribu breki za mbele na za nyuma.
text.en: Test the front and rear brakes.

text.sw: Washa taa ya mbele, taa ya nyuma na taa za kuashiria.
text.en: Switch on the headlight, the tail light and the indicators.

text.sw: Dereva anaondoka na breki mbovu.
text.en: A rider leaves with weak brakes.

why.en: Danger! Do not ride. Fix the brakes first.

text.sw: Dereva anakagua mnyororo na kuweka mafuta kabla ya safari.
text.en: A rider checks the chain and adds fuel before the trip.

why.sw: Salama! Ukaguzi mdogo unazuia ajali kubwa.
why.en: Safe! A small check prevents a big crash.

text.sw: Vaa kofia ngumu kila safari, hata safari fupi.
text.en: Wear a helmet on every trip, even a short one.

text.sw: Funga kamba ya kofia. Kofia isiyofungwa huruka wakati wa ajali.
text.en: Fasten the helmet strap. A helmet that is not fastened comes off in a crash.

text.sw: Vaa jaketi la kuakisi mwanga ili madereva wengine wakuone.
text.en: Wear a reflective vest so other drivers can see you.

text.sw: Vaa glovu na viatu vinavyofunika miguu.
text.en: Wear gloves and closed shoes.

text.sw: Dereva amevaa kofia lakini kamba haijafungwa.
text.en: A rider wears a helmet but the strap is open.

text.sw: Dereva anaendesha akiwa amevaa ndala.
text.en: A rider rides in flip-flops.

why.sw: Hatari! Ndala hazilindi miguu. Vaa viatu vinavyofunika.
why.en: Danger! Flip-flops do not protect your feet. Wear closed shoes.

text.sw: Dereva na abiria wote wamevaa kofia zilizofungwa.
text.en: The rider and the passenger both wear fastened helmets.

why.en: Safe! The passenger also needs a helmet.

text.sw: Endesha kwa mwendo wa wastani. Mwendo kasi unaua.
text.en: Ride at a moderate speed. Speed kills.

text.sw: Acha nafasi kubwa kati yako na gari lililo mbele.
text.en: Keep a big gap between you and the vehicle in front.

text.sw: Mvua na matope hufanya barabara iteleze. Punguza mwendo na breki taratibu.
text.en: Rain and mud make the road slippery. Slow down and brake gently.

text.sw: Usiku, washa taa na endesha polepole zaidi.
text.en: At night, switch on your lights and ride more slowly.

text.sw: Dereva anapita lori kwenye kona bila kuona mbele.
text.en: A rider overtakes a lorry on a bend without seeing ahead.

why.sw: Hatari! Pita tu pale unapoona barabara iko wazi mbele.
why.en: Danger! Only overtake when you can see a clear road ahead.

text.sw: Dereva anasimama na kuangalia kushoto na kulia kwenye makutano.
text.en: A rider stops and looks left and right at a junction.

why.sw: Salama! Angalia pande zote kabla ya kuvuka.
why.en: Safe! Look both ways before you cross.

text.sw: Beba abiria mmoja tu.
text.en: Carry only one passenger.

text.sw: Abiria lazima avae kofia ngumu iliyofungwa.
text.en: The passenger must wear a fastened helmet.

text.sw: Funga mzigo vizuri. Mzigo mzito au mpana unaweza kukuangusha.
text.en: Tie the load well. A heavy or wide load can make you fall.

text.sw: Dereva amebeba abiria watatu.
text.en: A rider carries three passengers.

text.sw: Mzigo ni mpana kuliko pikipiki na unazuia vioo.
text.en: The load is wider than the motorcycle and blocks the mirrors.

why.sw: Hatari! Punguza mzigo au tumia usafiri mwingine.
why.en: Danger! Make the load smaller or use other transport.

text.sw: Abiria mmoja, amevaa kofia na ameshika vizuri.
text.en: One passenger, wearing a helmet and holding on well.

why.en: Safe! This is the correct way.

text.sw: Usinywe pombe kabla ya kuendesha. Pombe hupunguza uwezo wa kuona na kuamua.
text.en: Do not drink alcohol before you ride. Alcohol makes you slow to see and to decide.

text.sw: Usitumie simu ukiendesha. Simama pembeni kwanza.
text.en: Do not use your phone while you ride. Stop at the side of the road first.

text.sw: Ukichoka, pumzika. Usingizi unaweza kuja ghafla.
text.en: If you are tired, rest. Sleep can come suddenly.

text.sw: Dereva anaongea na simu huku akiendesha.
text.en: A rider talks on the phone while riding.

why.sw: Hatari! Simama pembeni kabla ya kupokea simu.
why.en: Danger! Stop at the side of the road before you answer.

text.sw: Dereva amekunywa bia mbili tu na anasema yuko sawa.
text.en: A rider had only two beers and feels fine.

why.sw: Hatari! Hata pombe kidogo ni hatari. Usiendeshe.
why.en: Danger! Even a little alcohol is dangerous. Do not ride.

text.sw: Dereva aliyechoka anasimama kupumzika kwa dakika ishirini.
text.en: A tired rider stops to rest for twenty minutes.

text.sw: Kwanza, jilinde. Weka alama ya hatari ili magari mengine yapunguze mwendo.
text.en: First, keep yourself safe. Warn other traffic so they slow down.

text.sw: Piga simu ya dharura, 112. Sema mahali ulipo na idadi ya majeruhi.
text.en: Call the emergency number, 112. Say where you are and how many people are hurt.

text.sw: Usimvue kofia mtu aliyejeruhiwa. Unaweza kuumiza shingo yake.
text.en: Do not take off an injured person's helmet. You can hurt their neck.

text.sw: Kama damu inatoka sana, bonyeza jeraha kwa kitambaa safi.
text.en: If there is a lot of bleeding, press on the wound with a clean cloth.

text.sw: Watu wanamwinua haraka mtu aliyeumia shingo.
text.en: People quickly lift a person with a neck injury.

why.sw: Hatari! Usimsogeze, isipokuwa kuna moto au hatari kubwa.
why.en: Danger! Do not move them unless there is a fire or other serious danger.

text.sw: Mtu anapiga 112 na kueleza mahali ajali ilipotokea.
text.en: Someone calls 112 and says where the crash is.
